title: The imperfect: how the cities were

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the imperfect (*era*, *tenía*) from A2 Unit 21: it describes how things were and what used to happen. In history it paints the scene before you tell an event: *Buenos Aires crecía*, *las ciudades tenían tranvías*.

items.spanish: Buenos Aires crecía todos los años.
Las ciudades tenían avenidas anchas, plazas y edificios nuevos.
items.english: The cities had wide avenues, squares and new buildings.

items.spanish: Los tranvías llevaban a la gente de un barrio a otro.
items.english: The trams took people from one neighbourhood to another.

items.spanish: Los obreros salían temprano de casa y volvían tarde.
items.english: The workers left home early and came back late.

sections.content: Use the imperfect for the scene and for what went on and on (*crecía*, *tenían*, *llevaban*). For one event with a date, use the preterite: *En 1905 se abrió la Avenida Central*.
